items.text: Develop and maintain BMC firmware for AI servers, including OpenBMC platform bring-up and feature development (embedded Linux experience acceptable if no prior OpenBMC exposure).
Implement and integrate low-level drivers (U-Boot, Device Tree, Kernel), covering I2C, SPI, PMBus, GPIO, and other interfaces.
Build and maintain BMC sensor monitoring, FRU/SDR tables, fan/power control, and event log systems.
Implement management protocols and firmware update mechanisms (IPMI, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP).
Integrate Secure Boot / TPM / SPDM security frameworks.
If experienced with NVIDIA HGX/DGX/NVSwitch projects, support GPU power/thermal control, firmware updates, and OOB management integration.
Prepare design documents, test plans, mass production support materials, and debug reports.

6.If experienced with NVIDIA HGX/DGX/NVSwitch projects, support GPU power/thermal control, firmware updates, and OOB management integration.
